item.title: Palau launches national anti-drug task force for 2026 ‘Just Say No’ campaign
item.description: KOROR (Island Times/Pacnews) — Palau President Surangel Whipps Jr. has issued executive order No. 498 establishing a National Working Group on the Fight Against Illegal Drugs, launching a coordinated national response for 2026, declared the Year to “Just Say No” to Illegal Drugs. item.title: Rev & Tax announces start of 2026 filing season
item.description: (Press Release) — The CNMI Department of Finance’s Division of Revenue and Taxation has officially announced the start of the 2026 tax filing season. Current tax forms and instructions are available at www.finance.gov.mp/forms/. Taxpayers must use the most recent version, forms from prior years used to report current year will not be accepted. The post Rev & Tax announces start of 2026 filing season appeared first on Marianas Variety News & Views.
